tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Average Annual Financial Turnover of the Tenderer should not be less than the Amount Put to Tender (However it will be 50% in respect of Micro & Small Enterprises) during the 3 Financial Years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 or 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-2026. The audited balance sheets (including profit and loss account sheet) signed by CAs with UDIN and signed by the authorized signatory of the firm for each of the i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 or 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-2026 shall be scanned and uploaded.Micro & Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME (UDYAM) registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that tenderer is a Micro and Small Enterprises.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Liquid Assets as on last date of previous month of tender inviting date or at a later date before submission of the bid consisting of Cash at Bank plus Term Deposits plus availability of fund based credit facilities in any Nationalized/scheduled Bank shall not be less than 25% of the amount put to tender (However it will be 12.5% in respect of Micro & Small Enterprises). The cash at bank, term deposits and availability of fund based credit facilities shall be supported by a certificate issued by Nationalized/ scheduled Bank shall be uploaded in the prescribed format Annexure-B.If the Tenderer has banking with more than one Bank, then the available liquid assets mentioned above on a particular date i.e., as on last date of previous month of tender inviting date or any date before submission of tender shall be the same date for all the banks.In case of Fund based credit facility, the certificate issued by the Nationalized/ Scheduled Bank duly mentioning sanctioned limits, funds utilized so far and balance available as on last date of previous month of tender inviting date or at a later date, before submission of the bid shall be uploaded.

Bidder should be Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or authorized Agent or dealer of the original manufacturer and should have at least 10(Ten) years of experience in design and manufacturing of similar or better testing or measuring equipment. Documentary evidence such as Factory License, Manufacturers registration certificate , Manufacturers License to be provided.In case of authorized dealer, the bidder shall furnish authorization letter issued by the Manufacturer.Note- The bidder should furnish an under taking to support spares, Services for the period of 10(Ten) years from date of commission. (Self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- in this regard shall be uploaded.

The bidder should have manufctured and supplied at least 80%(40% inrescpect of Micro and Micro & Small Enterprises) of the tendered quantituy of material/Equivalent of same or Higher type sepcified in the tender in any of Gov./leading public sectors in India like POWERGRID/ NTPC/ NHPC/ BHEL/ CPRI or State owned/Central Transmission/ Generation Utilities during the last 5 (five) financial years (i.e.2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 or 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-2027) up to the date of submission of bids.Purchase order copies for the specified period to be uploaded & performance certificate issued by the Officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre for the respective POs shall be uploaded.(The PO copies shall be in the name of OEM or OEM authorised agent/dealer)
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Purchase order copies and performance certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Purchase order copies and performance certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall furnish Test Certificates not older than Seven years as on the date of bid opening for having conducted successful tests in a NABL accredited test house as per the relevant IS/IEC standards on the equipment/material specified in the bid.In case the test reports for the specified equipment/material in the present enquiry are older than 07 years or if one/some of the test reports are not available for the specified equipment/material in the present enquiry, in that case the bidder shall give an undertaking agreeing to conduct all tests on the 1st Unit or any other unit at the discretion of GESCOM in a NABL Accredited Laboratory if order is placed on the firm without affecting the Delivery Schedule and at no extra cost to GESCOM. Bidders shall have to upload the test certificates of the material/ equipment specified in the present enquiry as per the relevant IS/IEC standards.

The bidder shall upload the GTP of the tendered material matching to the GESCOM specification failing which the Bid documents is liable for rejections. GTP of tendered material matching to the GESCOM specification shall be uploaded.

The bidder or manufacturer of Tendered material/equipment shall have full-fledged service center in India for complete after sales service of the Tendered material/ equipment. The complete after sales service of the Tendered material/equipment shall be provided within reasonable time and the same has to be guaranteed for a period of 10 years from the date of commission. The bidder shall furnish the details of service center in India.The bidder shall furnish Self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- in this regard shall be uploaded.

The bidders whose equipment meets the above qualifying requirements should be prepared to demonstrate / arrange for demonstration of tendered equipment before the GESCOM Officer on the date which will be intimated later after issue of P.O. and before offering complete quantity for inspection. Failure to demonstrate their equipment on the notified date will lead to termination of the P.O. The bidder shall arrange for demonstration of his equipment at his own cost and risk at any 33/11KV Station in GESCOM Jurisdiction. The equipment meeting the required specification (specified in Technical specification) during demonstration shall only be considered as technically acceptable entire quantity will be considered for inspection. The bidder has to submitt consent in the form of Self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- in this regard shall be uploaded.

The bidder shall make necessary arrangement to provide training to GESCOM Officials, about the operation, maintenance material at the cost of the bidder. Further after installation at the destination place, practical demonstration & training shall also be provided at the cost of the bidder.Self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- in this regard shall be uploaded

Any Tenderer from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Tenderer is registered with the Competent Authority. A certificate for having read the clauses specified in Section-XVI of the tender documents under the heading Eligibility clauses in respect of restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer of a country which shares a land border with India shall be uploaded by the Tenderer in the following format: i)I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer of a country which shares a land border with India I certify that this Tenderer is not from such a country or, if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this Tenderer, fulfills all requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered. (Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached/ uploaded.) ii) I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/vendor having Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangement. I certify that this Tenderer or does not have any ToT arrangement requiring registration with the competent authority. OR I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/vendor having Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangement. I certify that this Tenderer or vendor has valid registration to participate in this procurement .Registration certificate issued by the competent authority shall be uploaded. Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration certificate and Self declaration

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should not have been DEFAULTED in supplies against Purchase Orders placed by any ESCOMs/Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/PSUs.Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- by the Tenderer adhering to this clause shall be uploaded.

The Tenderer should not be under order of debarment/Blacklisting from participating in a Tender by any ESCOMs/Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs, as on the last date of submission of bids.Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- by the Tenderer adhering to this clause shall be uploaded.

Litigation History: The Tenderer should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years, A consistent history of awards involving litigation against the Tenderer or any partner may result in rejection of Bid.Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.
